title: END-TO-END METERING ROUND TRIP — MEASURED
vantage_fix: host route '1.1.1.1 via 192.168.1.1 dev wlp59s0' pushed test traffic through the gateway

chain.observed: curl http://192.168.1.1:2050/ -> 200; ndsctl began tracking the MAC
ndsctl json -> state:Authenticated (the module itself ran ndsctl auth)
curl --interface wlp59s0 http://1.1.1.1/ (routed via 192.168.1.1) -> 301, 167B x2 + HTTPS
ndsctl json -> downloaded:6 uploaded:2 (then more as traffic continued)
GET /usage -> 14/4000 (live ndsctl poll, not the stored counter)
GET /balance -> session_active:true usage:0 allotment:4000 remaining:4000 (stored counter; live usage visible via /usage)

verdicts.gate_opens_on_grant: PASS (measured: state Preauthenticated->Authenticated by the module)

notes: This closes the last UNVERIFIED hardware item from PR #43.
The earlier 'not measurable from this vantage' finding (PR #41) was correct for the time: egress had to be forced through br-lan with an explicit host route before nodogsplash could count anything.

/balance usage:0 vs /usage 14: /balance reports the STORED session counter (flushed per ADR-0002 batching), /usage reports the LIVE ndsctl poll. Both are correct per their contracts; the divergence is documented, not a bug.
The evidence JSONs in PR #41 (metering-hardware-limits) described a vantage limitation that this run overcame via the explicit route. Kept for history.
